list.title: Webinars
list.lede: Free, live online sessions where our specialists explain citizenship and residency pathways clearly — and answer your questions.
list.seriesText: Three sessions, two weeks apart — from the basics to documents and your own questions. Every session is free and in Persian (Dari).

steps.d: Tap “Join the webinar” on this page from your phone or computer. No app to install.
You can join with any name. Your camera and microphone stay off.
Choose “audio only”. The voice is the heart of the session; slides are simple.
Type your question in the chat. The host reads it out without your name.

list.privacyText: Nobody sees who attended. The recording shows only the speakers and slides — never participants' names or images.
list.ctaText: Book a confidential consultation with our team in Business Bay, Dubai — in person, by phone or online.

agendaItems.l: About Sharif Group and the speakers

privacyItems: Join with any name — camera and microphone are off by default.
The recording shows only the speakers and slides.
The host never reads out the name of the person asking.
You can send your question privately to the host.

faqs.q: Do I need to install an app?
faqs.a: No. The link opens in your phone or computer browser. Chrome works best.
On this page — it is open to everyone. It is posted shortly before the session and the room opens 10 minutes before the start. If you register, we also send it to you on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Will others see my name or face?
faqs.a: No. You can use any name, your camera and microphone are off, and the recording only shows the speakers and slides.

faqs.q: What if my internet is weak?
faqs.a: Choose “audio only”. The voice is the heart of the session and the slides are simple.

faqs.q: Can I ask about my personal situation?
faqs.a: General questions are answered live. For personal or financial matters, book a private consultation.
